_comment: WC 2026 knockout bracket (FIFA pre-planned structure for the 32-team round). Source: Wikipedia '2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage' + FIFA match schedule. R32 slots: {w:'X'}=winner group X, {r:'X'}=runner-up group X, {t:[...]}=best-third from one of these groups (FIFA's 5-group eligibility set per slot). KO rounds: {win:N}=winner of match N. Match 79 = Winner Group A (Mexico's slot), Match 74 = Winner Group E (Germany's slot). 3rd-place play-off (match 103) intentionally omitted (no MPP/bet relevance).
third_slots_note: Eight of twelve third-placed teams advance. Each '3rd' slot below lists the FIFA-eligible groups; engine/tournament.py assigns the eight qualifying thirds to these slots respecting eligibility (FIFA publishes one allocation per 495-combination; the engine finds a valid eligibility-respecting matching, which matches FIFA for the vast majority of combinations and is immaterial to aggregate probabilities).
